title: Beyond Functional Correctness: Static Code Quality Profiling of LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: 超越功能正确性：对大型语言模型生成代码的静态代码质量分析

paragraphs.en: 本文对大型语言模型生成的Python代码进行了大规模静态质量分析，重点关注其可维护性和可靠性。 Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet most evaluations still focus on whether generated code passes benchmark test suites. Functional correctness alone, however, provides only a limited view of quality: benchmark tests are often incomplete, and passing them does not guarantee that code is maintainable, reliable, or well-structured. This paper {presents a large-scale static quality profiling of} LLM-generated Python code, with a focus on maintainability and reliability. Using 65{,}663 programs from 73 models in LiveCodeBench, we evaluate generated code with established static analysis tools, including Pylint, Radon, and SonarQube. Our results show systematic differences across models that are not captured by correctness alone, with maintainability emerging as the clearest source of variation. We further find that correctness often comes with structural trade-offs rather than uniformly simpler solutions. Overall, our findings motivate evaluation frameworks that assess LLM-generated code beyond pass rates alone.
paragraphs.zh: 本文对大型语言模型生成的Python代码进行了大规模静态质量分析，重点关注其可维护性和可靠性。大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于代码生成，但大多数评估仍然集中在生成的代码能否通过基准测试套件上。 然而，仅凭功能正确性只能提供有限的质量视角：基准测试往往并不完整，而通过测试也并不能保证代码具备可维护性、可靠性或良好的结构。 本文{对大型语言模型生成的Python代码进行了大规模静态质量分析}，重点关注其可维护性和可靠性。 我们利用LiveCodeBench中来自73个模型的65{,}663个程序，使用Pylint、Radon和SonarQube等成熟的静态分析工具对生成的代码进行评估。 我们的研究结果表明，不同模型之间存在系统性的差异，而这些差异无法仅通过正确性来捕捉；其中，可维护性成为最明显的变异来源。 我们进一步发现，正确性往往伴随着结构上的权衡，而非统一更简单的解决方案。 总体而言，我们的研究结果推动了评估框架的发展，这些框架能够超越单纯的通过率来评估大型语言模型生成的代码。
